title: #089. Budgeted Robust Optimization (Bertsimas-Sim)
subtitle: Protect a capacity constraint against up to Gamma simultaneous resource deviations via exact LP duality.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { quantities, totalProfit }.
judge.m2: Worst-case capacity usage ({p0}) under gamma = {p2} exceeds capacityCap ({p1}).
judge.m3: Reported totalProfit ({p0}) does not match computed profit ({p1}).
judge.m4: Robustly feasible mix, but totalProfit ({p0}) is below robust optimum ({p1}).
